### A Prayer for Deliverance
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/prayer-deliverance
Passage: Psalm 6:1-10
Points:
- In times of affliction or deep trouble, believers should run directly to God rather than relying on self-reliance.
- Suffering is not always punishment for specific sin, but God uses hardship to draw believers closer to Himself.
- Scripture encourages believers to pour out their grief honestly before the Lord and ask for His mercy.
- Mourning in faith can transform into confident assurance that God hears our cries and will vindicate us.
- Trusting God's sovereignty reminds us that pain is purposeful and directed toward a good end.
